import numpy as np
from scipy.sparse import diags, eye, kron
from scipy.sparse.linalg import splu


def calibrate_affine_banks(raw_observations: np.ndarray, observation_banks: np.ndarray, reference_levels: np.ndarray, sweep_readouts: np.ndarray, sweep_banks: np.ndarray, *, historical_profiles: np.ndarray | None = None) -> np.ndarray:
    """Invert raw = gain * reference + offset for nonnegative integer bank IDs.

    Fit positive current slopes independently; from four sweeps onward, screen
    at 4.5 robust residual scales before refitting. No gain penalty is used.
    Historical profiles are complete (profile, bank ID, [gain, offset]) arrays
    in the current signal units. When a gain is missing, compare joint profiles
    using informative current banks, or available spots if none are informative.
    Tied profiles transfer only parameters on which they agree for a bank.
    Without an identified fit or usable profile the fallback is (1, 0), not an
    estimate of gain. Sparse sweeps update the offset at the chosen gain.
    """
    raw = np.asarray(raw_observations, dtype=float)
    banks = np.asarray(observation_banks)
    ref = np.asarray(reference_levels, dtype=float)
    reads = np.asarray(sweep_readouts, dtype=float)
    ids = np.asarray(sweep_banks)
    if raw.ndim != 1 or not raw.size or banks.shape != raw.shape:
        raise ValueError('Supply matched nonempty observation and bank vectors')
    if ref.ndim != 1 or reads.shape != ref.shape or ids.shape != ref.shape:
        raise ValueError('Supply matched sweep vectors')
    if any(not np.issubdtype(a.dtype, np.integer) or np.any(a < 0) for a in (banks, ids) if a.size):
        raise ValueError('Bank IDs must be nonnegative integers')
    count = int(max(banks.max(), ids.max() if ids.size else -1)) + 1
    checks = [(ref[ids == b], reads[ids == b]) for b in range(count)]
    params = np.tile([1., 0.], (count, 1))
    known = np.zeros(count, dtype=bool)
    spans = np.zeros(count)
    for b, (x, y) in enumerate(checks):
        if x.size < 2 or np.ptp(x) == 0:
            continue
        spans[b] = np.ptp(x)
        u, v = (x - np.median(x)) / spans[b], y - np.median(y)
        keep = np.ones(x.size, dtype=bool)
        if x.size >= 4:
            i, j = np.triu_indices(x.size, 1)
            du = u[j] - u[i]
            valid = np.abs(du) > 1e-12
            slopes = (v[j[valid]] - v[i[valid]]) / du[valid]
            slopes = slopes[slopes > 0]
            if slopes.size:
                residuals = v - slopes[:, None] * u
                errors = np.abs(residuals - np.median(residuals, axis=1)[:, None])
                scores = np.median(errors, axis=1)
                best = np.argmin(scores)
                scale = max(1.4826 * scores[best], 1e-12 * np.ptp(v))
                candidate = errors[best] <= 4.5 * scale
                if candidate.sum() >= 2 and np.ptp(u[candidate]) > 1e-12:
                    keep = candidate
        uc, vc = u[keep] - u[keep].mean(), v[keep] - v[keep].mean()
        gain = (uc @ vc) / (uc @ uc) / spans[b]
        if gain > 0:
            params[b] = gain, y[keep].mean() - gain * x[keep].mean()
            known[b] = True
    if historical_profiles is not None and not known.all() and ref.size:
        profiles = np.asarray(historical_profiles, dtype=float)
        if profiles.ndim != 3 or profiles.shape[1] < count or profiles.shape[2] != 2:
            raise ValueError('Historical profiles must cover the observed bank IDs')
        profiles = profiles[:, :count, :]
        if not np.isfinite(profiles).all() or np.any(profiles[..., 0] <= 0):
            raise ValueError('Historical gains must be positive and profile entries finite')
        if profiles.shape[0]:
            signal_scale = max(np.max(np.abs(ref)), np.max(np.abs(reads)))
            if known.any():
                delta = profiles[:, known] - params[known]
                score = np.median(np.hypot(delta[..., 0], delta[..., 1] / spans[known]), axis=1)
            else:
                errors = [np.median(np.abs(profiles[:, b, 0, None] * x + profiles[:, b, 1, None] - y), axis=1)
                          for b, (x, y) in enumerate(checks) if x.size]
                score = np.median(np.stack(errors, axis=1), axis=1)
                if signal_scale > 0:
                    score /= signal_scale
            best = profiles[score <= score.min() + 1e-12]
            for b in np.flatnonzero(~known):
                gain_agrees = np.ptp(best[:, b, 0]) <= 1e-12 * best[:, b, 0].max()
                # A current spot replaces the historical offset anyway.
                offset_agrees = checks[b][0].size > 0 or np.ptp(best[:, b, 1]) <= 1e-12 * signal_scale
                if gain_agrees and offset_agrees:
                    params[b] = best[0, b]
    for b in np.flatnonzero(~known):
        x, y = checks[b]
        if x.size:
            params[b, 1] = np.median(y - params[b, 0] * x)
    gain, offset = params[banks].T
    return (raw - offset) / gain


def coupled_transport_design(lengths: tuple[float, float], diffusivities: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray], velocities: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray], robin: tuple[float, float], baseline_reactions: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray], reaction_field: np.ndarray, source_modes: np.ndarray, shifts: np.ndarray, sensor_indices: np.ndarray, *, coupling_threshold: float = 1e-3, enhanced_diffusivity_factor: float = 1.45) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, float]:
    """Solve invertible shifted operators on a uniform cell-centered rectangle.

    Axis coefficients are cellwise; diffusivities have units L²/T, velocities
    and Robin transfer L/T, and reactions and shifts 1/T. Homogeneous Robin
    transfer uses the same rate at both faces of each axis. Discretization uses
    harmonic interior diffusion and the row-wise first-order upwind stencil.
    Keep the full added reaction and separate baseline reactions in both regimes.
    Multiply diffusivities by 1.45 only above the default relative coupling gate
    of 1e-3. These are prescribed closure parameters; no forward ridge is added.
    Return the shift-first sensor design, last-shift fields (nx, ny, M), and
    the relative Frobenius distance of the added reaction from additivity.
    """
    reaction = np.asarray(reaction_field, dtype=float)
    modes = np.asarray(source_modes, dtype=float)
    shifts = np.asarray(shifts, dtype=float)
    if reaction.ndim != 2 or not reaction.size or modes.ndim != 3 or modes.shape[1:] != reaction.shape or not modes.shape[0]:
        raise ValueError('Supply a nonempty reaction grid and grid-shaped source modes')
    if shifts.ndim != 1 or not shifts.size or coupling_threshold < 0 or enhanced_diffusivity_factor <= 0:
        raise ValueError('Supply shifts and valid regime parameters')
    nx, ny = reaction.shape
    norm_scale = np.max(np.abs(reaction))
    coupling = 0.0
    if norm_scale > 0:
        v = reaction / norm_scale
        defect = v - v.mean(axis=0) - v.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True) + v.mean()
        coupling = float(np.linalg.norm(defect) / np.linalg.norm(v))
    factor = enhanced_diffusivity_factor if coupling > coupling_threshold else 1.0
    axes = []
    for a, n in enumerate(reaction.shape):
        k, vel, base = (np.asarray(coeff[a], dtype=float) for coeff in (diffusivities, velocities, baseline_reactions))
        length, transfer = lengths[a], robin[a]
        if k.shape != (n,) or vel.shape != (n,) or base.shape != (n,):
            raise ValueError('Each axis coefficient must have one value per cell')
        if length <= 0 or transfer < 0 or np.any(k <= 0):
            raise ValueError('Require positive lengths and diffusivities, nonnegative Robin transfer')
        # Use the unit interval on each axis; k, vel and transfer now have rate units.
        h = 1.0 / n
        k, vel, transfer = factor * k / length**2, vel / length, transfer / length
        p, m = np.maximum(vel, 0) / h, np.maximum(-vel, 0) / h
        q = (2 * k[:-1] * k[1:] / (k[:-1] + k[1:])) / h**2
        main = base + p + m
        main[:-1] += q
        main[1:] += q
        end = np.array([0, n - 1])
        np.add.at(main, end, transfer * k[end] / (h * (transfer * h / 2 + k[end])))
        axes.append(diags(main, format='csc') if n == 1 else
                    diags((-q - p[1:], main, -q - m[:-1]), (-1, 0, 1), format='csc'))
    op = (kron(axes[0], eye(ny), format='csc') + kron(eye(nx), axes[1], format='csc')
          + diags(reaction.ravel(order='C'), format='csc'))
    sensors = np.asarray(sensor_indices)
    if sensors.ndim != 2 or sensors.shape[1] != 2 or not np.issubdtype(sensors.dtype, np.integer):
        raise ValueError('Supply integer cell indices with shape (sensor, 2)')
    if np.any(sensors < 0) or np.any(sensors >= (nx, ny)):
        raise ValueError('Sensor cell index outside the grid')
    i, j = sensors.T
    identity = eye(nx * ny, format='csc')
    rhs = modes.reshape(modes.shape[0], nx * ny, order='C').T
    rows = []
    for shift in shifts:
        field = splu(op + shift * identity).solve(rhs).reshape(nx, ny, modes.shape[0], order='C')
        rows.append(field[i, j])
    return np.vstack(rows), field, coupling


def fit_box_simplex(design: np.ndarray, observations: np.ndarray, nuisance: np.ndarray, *, cap: float, budget: float, source_ridge: float, nuisance_ridge: float = 0.0) -> tuple[np.ndarray, dict[str, float | np.ndarray]]:
    """Fit the fixed-budget box-constrained ridge objective and certify it.

    Minimize (||R(Dw-y)||² + source_ridge*||w||²)/2 for 0<=w<=cap.
    R is the direct ridge-fit residual operator on the nuisance columns, not
    its square root. Nuisance ridge defaults to zero (orthogonal projection);
    use an array of shape (n_rows, 0) for no nuisance. Strictly positive source
    ridge is required. Ridge values scale with squared column units in their
    respective designs. The active-set gradient tolerance is 1e-12 after
    normalizing the weights and objective. Multipliers obey g-nu-lower+upper=0.
    """
    D, y, Z = (np.asarray(a, dtype=float) for a in (design, observations, nuisance))
    if D.ndim != 2 or y.shape != (D.shape[0],) or Z.ndim != 2 or Z.shape[0] != D.shape[0]:
        raise ValueError('Design, observations and nuisance must share rows')
    n = D.shape[1]
    if n == 0 or cap <= 0 or not 0 <= budget <= n * cap or source_ridge <= 0 or nuisance_ridge < 0:
        raise ValueError('Require feasible bounds, positive source ridge and nonnegative nuisance ridge')
    data = np.column_stack((D, y))
    if Z.shape[1]:
        if nuisance_ridge == 0:
            data -= Z @ np.linalg.lstsq(Z, data, rcond=None)[0]
        else:
            U, s, _ = np.linalg.svd(Z, full_matrices=False)
            shrinkage = s**2 / (s**2 + nuisance_ridge)
            data -= U @ (shrinkage[:, None] * (U.T @ data))
    S, r = data[:, :-1], data[:, -1]
    A = cap * S
    H = A.T @ A + source_ridge * cap**2 * np.eye(n)
    c = -(A.T @ r)
    scale = max(np.max(np.abs(H)), np.max(np.abs(c)))
    H, c = H / scale, c / scale
    if budget == 0:
        x, nu = np.zeros(n), c.min()
    elif budget == n * cap:
        x = np.ones(n)
        nu = (H @ x + c).max()
    else:
        x = np.full(n, budget / (n * cap))
        state = np.zeros(n, dtype=int)
        for _ in range(100 * n):
            g = H @ x + c
            free = np.flatnonzero(state == 0)
            if not free.size:
                lo = np.argmin(np.where(state < 0, g, np.inf))
                hi = np.argmax(np.where(state > 0, g, -np.inf))
                if g[hi] - g[lo] <= 1e-12:
                    nu = (g[hi] + g[lo]) / 2
                    break
                state[[lo, hi]] = 0
                continue
            block = H[np.ix_(free, free)]
            a, b = np.linalg.solve(block, np.column_stack((g[free], np.ones(free.size)))).T
            nu = a.sum() / b.sum()
            step = nu * b - a
            alpha = np.full(free.size, np.inf)
            np.divide(1 - x[free], step, out=alpha, where=step > 1e-14)
            np.divide(-x[free], step, out=alpha, where=step < -1e-14)
            hit = int(alpha.argmin())
            if alpha[hit] < 1:
                x[free] += max(0., alpha[hit]) * step
                state[free[hit]] = 1 if step[hit] > 0 else -1
                x[free[hit]] = float(state[free[hit]] > 0)
                continue
            x[free] += step
            violation = state * (H @ x + c - nu)
            release = violation.argmax()
            if violation[release] <= 1e-12:
                break
            state[release] = 0
        else:
            raise RuntimeError('Box-simplex active set did not converge')
    w = np.clip(x, 0., 1.) * cap
    nu = float(nu * scale / cap)
    residual = S @ w - r
    g = S.T @ residual + source_ridge * w
    lower = np.maximum(g - nu, 0.)
    upper = np.maximum(nu - g, 0.)
    primal = float(0.5 * (residual @ residual + source_ridge * (w @ w)))
    # Minimize the affine tangent plus the equality multiplier over the box.
    bound = primal + nu * (budget - w.sum()) - lower @ w - upper @ (cap - w)
    return w, {'weights': w.copy(), 'nu_sum': nu, 'lam_lower': lower, 'lam_upper': upper,
               'primal_objective': primal, 'dual_lower_bound': float(bound)}

def run_self_test():
    lengths = (2., 4.)
    k = (np.array([1., 3.]), np.array([2., 6.]))
    v = (np.array([-.4, .2]), np.array([.6, .2]))
    robin = (.5, .4)
    base = (np.array([.2, .6]), np.array([.4, .1]))
    shifts = np.array([.2, .8])
    sensors = np.array([[1, 1], [0, 0], [1, 0], [0, 1]])
    perm = np.array([2, 0, 3, 1])
    row_perm = np.r_[perm, len(sensors) + perm]
    truth = np.array([[[1., 0., 0.], [0., 2., 0.]], [[0., 0., 3.], [1., -1., .5]]])
    for interaction, factor in ((0., 1.), (.6, 1.45)):
        f = factor
        reaction = np.array([[.1, .2], [.3, .4 + interaction]])
        # Independent two-cell stencils in physical units: dx=1, dy=2.
        qx, qy = 1.5*f, .75*f
        Ax = np.array([[qx+.4+.2+.5*f/(.25+f), -qx-.4],
                       [-qx-.2, qx+.2+.6+1.5*f/(.25+3*f)]])
        By = np.array([[qy+.3+.4+.8*f/(2*(.4+2*f)), -qy],
                       [-qy-.1, qy+.1+.1+2.4*f/(2*(.4+6*f))]])
        op = np.kron(Ax, np.eye(2)) + np.kron(np.eye(2), By) + np.diag(reaction.ravel())
        rhs = (op + shifts[-1]*np.eye(4)) @ truth.reshape(4, 3)
        modes = rhs.T.reshape(3, 2, 2)
        design, terminal, coupling = coupled_transport_design(lengths, k, v, robin, base, reaction, modes, shifts, sensors)
        expected_coupling = interaction / (2*np.linalg.norm(reaction))
        np.testing.assert_allclose(coupling, expected_coupling, atol=2e-15)
        assert (coupling > 1e-3) == (factor > 1.)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(terminal, truth, atol=2e-12)
        first = np.linalg.solve(op + shifts[0]*np.eye(4), rhs).reshape(2, 2, 3)
        i, j = sensors.T
        np.testing.assert_allclose(design, np.vstack((first[i, j], truth[i, j])), atol=2e-12)
        # Convert length units by 0.01 and rate units by 2; permute sensor rows.
        ell, rate = .01, 2.
        scaled_design, scaled_terminal, scaled_coupling = coupled_transport_design(
            tuple(ell*a for a in lengths), tuple(ell**2*rate*a for a in k),
            tuple(ell*rate*a for a in v), tuple(ell*rate*a for a in robin),
            tuple(rate*a for a in base), rate*reaction, rate*modes, rate*shifts, sensors[perm])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(scaled_design, design[row_perm], atol=2e-12)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(scaled_terminal, terminal, atol=2e-12)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(scaled_coupling, coupling, atol=2e-15)
        assert all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (design, terminal, scaled_design, scaled_terminal, coupling, scaled_coupling))

    # The known optimum has one lower, one upper, and one free weight.
    w_true, g_true, ridge = np.array([0., .4, .6]), np.array([.3, .1, -.2]), .2
    Z = np.zeros((len(design), 1)); Z[0, 0] = 1.
    d = np.ones(len(design)); d[0] = .5  # Diagonal of direct residual operator with ridge 1.
    raw_residual = np.linalg.lstsq(design.T * d**2, g_true - ridge*w_true, rcond=None)[0]
    y = design @ w_true - raw_residual
    gain, offset = np.array([1.6, .75, 1.2, .85]), np.array([.2, -.1, .3, -.4])
    old = np.column_stack((gain, offset)); old[2, 1] = .1
    latest = np.column_stack((np.ones(4), np.zeros(4)))
    profiles = np.stack((old, latest))
    ids = np.array([0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 2])
    ref = np.array([-2., -1., 0., 1., 2., -1., 2., 1.5])
    reads = gain[ids]*ref + offset[ids]; reads[2] += 25.
    banks = np.array([0, 1, 2, 3, 0, 3, 2, 1])
    raw = gain[banks]*y + offset[banks]
    calibrated = calibrate_affine_banks(raw, banks, ref, reads, ids, historical_profiles=profiles)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(calibrated, y, atol=2e-12)
    missing = calibrate_affine_banks(raw, banks, ref, reads, ids, historical_profiles=profiles[1:])
    assert np.max(np.abs(missing - y)) > .01
    signal = 1e-3
    scaled_profiles = profiles.copy(); scaled_profiles[..., 1] *= signal
    scaled_y = calibrate_affine_banks(signal*raw[row_perm], banks[row_perm], signal*ref,
                                      signal*reads, ids, historical_profiles=scaled_profiles[::-1])
    np.testing.assert_allclose(scaled_y, signal*y[row_perm], atol=2e-14)

    w, cert = fit_box_simplex(design, calibrated, Z, cap=.6, budget=1., source_ridge=ridge, nuisance_ridge=1.)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(w, w_true, atol=2e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(w.sum(), 1., atol=2e-12)
    assert np.all((0 <= w) & (w <= .6))
    np.testing.assert_allclose(terminal @ w, truth @ w_true, atol=2e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cert['nu_sum'], .1, atol=2e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cert['lam_lower'], [.2, 0., 0.], atol=2e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cert['lam_upper'], [0., 0., .3], atol=2e-11)
    objective = .5*(np.linalg.norm(d*raw_residual)**2 + ridge*(w_true @ w_true))
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cert['primal_objective'], objective, atol=2e-12)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cert['dual_lower_bound'], objective, atol=2e-12)
    scaled_w, scaled_cert = fit_box_simplex(signal*scaled_design, scaled_y, Z[row_perm], cap=.6, budget=1.,
                                           source_ridge=ridge*signal**2, nuisance_ridge=1.)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(scaled_w, w, atol=2e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(scaled_cert['dual_lower_bound']/signal**2, objective, atol=2e-12)
    assert all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (calibrated, scaled_y, w, scaled_w, *cert.values(), *scaled_cert.values()))


run_self_test()
